standard.name: ASTM E2580
standard.title: Ultrasonic Testing of Flat Panel Composites and Sandwich Core Materials Used in Aerospace Applications

procedures.A: Pulse echo, non-contacting or contacting, one-sided access, 0.5 to 20 MHz longitudinal wave.
procedures.B: Through transmission, two transducers, two-sided access, 0.5 to 20 MHz longitudinal wave, automated and recorded.

scope.acceptanceCriteria: Not specified by this standard; contractually defined.

equipment.electronicEquipment: Capable of producing and processing signals over the search-unit frequency range.
equipment.searchUnits: Longitudinal straight-beam units with flat or focused acoustic lenses matched to contact or squirter setup.
equipment.alarm: Adjustable threshold; not required on systems that record amplitude data.
equipment.gateSync: Pulse-echo gate should lock to first interface pulse; through-transmission gate covers positive/negative horizontal movement.
equipment.squirter: Must provide laminar coupling fluid flow at all inspection angles.
equipment.scanRecord: Recording must not show backlash or hysteresis that hinders detection or evaluation.

referenceBlocks.ARP5605: Solid composite laminate reference standard guidance.

generalRequirements.inProcess: Use automated equipment capable of electronic recording for flat panel composite or honeycomb structures.
generalRequirements.inService: Manual contact may be used for suspected damage areas with an acoustically similar reference standard.
generalRequirements.coverage: Scanning speed, index increment, and step size must cause target simulated anomaly to register three times at the agreed threshold.
generalRequirements.frequencySelection: Select based on material and anticipated discontinuity type.
generalRequirements.techniqueRecord: Approved by Level III and includes part/zone, inspector, procedure, equipment, coverage sketches, and repeatable control settings.

procedureA.name: Pulse Echo
procedureA.referenceBlockSelection: Based on test objective; step wedges for ply count/debond/delamination, FBH for discontinuity size at known depth.

standardization.referenceDiscontinuity: Smallest unacceptable discontinuity nearest the depth zone, or nearest back surface for full thickness.
standardization.transfer: Adjust for attenuation differences between reference and part using back-surface response.

scan.minimumOverlap: 1/4 of front-surface spot diameter for non-contact, or 1/4 of transducer diameter for contact.
scan.speedFormula: maximum speed = (1 - overlap) * spot size * PRR / averages
scan.evaluation: Size reference and anomalies using -6 dB half-amplitude drop points with linear settings.

procedureB.name: Through Transmission
setup: Seal parts to prevent water ingress.
Open-ended sandwich panels must not be immersed.
Water columns normal to laminate surface and parallel to honeycomb cell walls.
Adjust squirters for smooth laminar intersecting flow.
procedureB.standardization: Set 100 percent first received signal in a good reference area and gate first received signal.
procedureB.scan: Trace multiple scan areas to part scan instructions; inspect tapered parts by zones to maintain 100 percent received signal.

systemPerformance: Check gain, distance-amplitude relationship, and alarm trigger after power interruption, personnel change, component replacement, or non-repeatable adjustment.
Perform interim checks as needed to support recovery and reinspection.
Test system linearity/performance yearly per ASTM E1324 or ASTM E317.
Evaluate search units periodically per ASTM E1065/E1065M.
qualityAssurance.wettingAgentControl: Check wetting agent after initial makeup and every 90 days when used.

documentation: Test method, specimen preparation, geometry, conditioning, equipment, transducer, environment, loading, raw/normalized data, and statistics per ASTM E1434
Written Level III-approved procedure/report with part, equipment, search units, fixtures, couplant, scan plan, transfer, acceptance classes, water paths, index, DAC, and evaluation procedure

systemUse.autoFillProfile: Composite flat panel or sandwich core UT profile.
